create_ProbabilisticRaysampler: create a ProbabilisticRaysampler module to importance sample points along rays using ray weights for NeRF fine rendering
run_ProbabilisticRaysampler_forward: run the ProbabilisticRaysampler forward pass with an input RayBundle and ray weights tensor to get importance sampled rays
create_NeRFRaysampler: create a NeRFRaysampler module to sample random rays during training or grid ray chunks during evaluation for NeRF rendering
run_NeRFRaysampler_precache_rays: run the NeRFRaysampler precache_rays method to precompute and cache ray bundles for a list of cameras before training
run_NeRFRaysampler_forward: run the NeRFRaysampler forward pass with cameras to get a RayBundle with origins, directions, lengths, and image coordinates
